subject.portfolio: mix M6 [QQQ/QLD] from reports/portfolio_mix_study.json: equity_core 0.80 (SPY) + lev_trend 0.20 (QLD while QQQ > 200-day SMA, else BIL)

profiles.2x: gross 2.0 scaled by the active 12% volatility-target overlay

subject.config_commit: the release that carries paper_portfolio.sleeves = {equity_core: 0.80, lev_trend: 0.20, tsmom: 0, trend: 0, mom_ls: 0}

start: the first full session on the image that carries the M6 config (expected 2026-09-16 or the next trading day after deploy); the start equity is that session's first snapshot
start_confirmed_note: v1.3.0 (the M6 config) went live on the server 2026-09-15 ~09:29 ET, ahead of that day's 09:47/09:51 ET full runs, which executed the M6 rotation the same day rather than the next one this document anticipated. This field only fills in the concrete anchor the 'start' field above always pointed to (the first M6-config session's first snapshot, taken from state/paper.db / state/paper_2x.db directly, not this timestamp, which exists so engine.sleeve_pnl has a since= cursor to query from) — it does not change any rule, threshold, or methodology.

window.note: ~3 months, then ~6 months before any real-money discussion

benchmark: SPY total return over the identical sessions, taken from the SPY mark inside each snapshot's positions blob (the same construction as the 2026-09-14 forensic decomposition), rf = BIL

kill_rules.evaluated: daily from session 20 onward, at the last snapshot of the day
kill_rules.structured_fields_note: the four fields above are machine-readable extractions of K1/K2/K3's prose rules below for engine.sleeve_pnl.validation_kill_rule_status (scripts/weekly.py's Phase-4 monitoring); they restate, not revise, those rules

rules.rule: portfolio return since start minus SPY return since start < -4.0 pp
rules.action: stand the lev_trend sleeve down (config: lev_trend 0.0, equity_core 1.00) and reopen the campaign; base keeps SPY

rules.rule: drawdown from the validation-window peak deeper than 10% (base) or 20% (2x) while SPY's own drawdown over the same span is shallower by more than the paired-bootstrap band
mean notional-weighted adverse slippage over the window above 25 bp per order
rules.action: execution review before anything else; not a strategy verdict

rules.rule: any session where lev_trend is on but QLD is held at less than 15% of equity for reasons other than the drift band (cap shrink, buying-power shrink, rejected order)
rules.action: config/gate defect; fix before the clock resumes

pass_rule_at_63_sessions.return: portfolio minus SPY >= -1.0 pp since start (the sleeve is 20% of the book; a 3-month window cannot resolve a +2.4 pp/yr expectation, so the bar is 'not worse than SPY within noise')
pass_rule_at_63_sessions.drawdown: max drawdown within paired_drawdown_noise_pp(spy, portfolio) of SPY's
pass_rule_at_63_sessions.signal_integrity: every QQQ/200-DMA flip in the window was traded on the next full run (from the journal's lev_trend orders)
pass_rule_at_63_sessions.then: extend to 126 sessions; the 126-session pass rule is portfolio minus SPY >= 0 pp and drawdown within band

monitoring.tool: the per-sleeve mark-to-market decomposition (per symbol per run: qty_prev*(mark-px_prev) + sum(dq*(mark-fill)), half-open windows, sleeve from snapshots.diag.origin) — to be promoted into scripts/weekly.py so the weekly report carries per-sleeve P&L vs SPY
monitoring.sequential_test: optional: the Wald SPRT form in backtest/iwm_compression_breakout_forward_test.py on daily (portfolio - SPY) excess returns, mu0 = 0, mu1 = +2.4 pp/yr / 252, sigma from the mix study's realized tracking error; parameters to be fixed in a separate registration before use

prohibitions: no config change to the M6 weights, the 200-day length, the vehicle, or the reserve during the window except by a kill rule
no study may tune anything on 2026-08-13+ data; the validation journal is read only by the monitoring tool and the kill rules
a kill or a pass is declared by the rule, not by a fresh opinion about the market
known_gaps: The 2023+ heldout margin in the mix study is thin (excess Sharpe 1.18 vs 1.16); the durable evidence is the full 2006+ sample (13.9% vs 11.5% CAGR, GFC -49.9% vs -55.2%) and 16 of 21 calendar years ahead of SPY.
The sleeve carries SPY-like drawdowns (GFC -50%); the kill rules bound the validation window, not a future bear market.
The simulator carries no stops; equity_core and lev_trend are therefore stop-exempt in config so the live book matches the evidence. The daily/monthly/peak kill switches remain.
The 2x lab's overlay-scaled version was not simulated (gross 2.0 fixed was); the lab is judged on the same rules relative to SPY but is a learning account.
